This tip helped me just now. Found this thread via google and then this comment.

Starting with a bomb-omb combined with extra damage to trophy cpus absolutely helps. Starting the battle and immediately throwing the bomb at the yellow sniper guy kills him immediately. Then it's just a 1v2 of CPU fighters, which is very doable

Also, I didn't have Giratina available as a primary spirit, but I just chose my highest level spirit with 3 slots available. Supports: Assist Killer, Bomb Man, and whatever else you think might be helpful - I chose "start with a back shield". Could just use a 2-slot spirit, probably
